scope: Complete phased plan structure and consistency with supplied discovery constraints, not repeat data inventory or implementation tests
pass_means: May proceed P0 evidence closure then P1 mapping and minimal research-contract freeze within each explicitly authorized file set; not an executable factor rule or efficacy acceptance.

constraints_checked.plan_response: Distinguishes existing records from valid historical observations; causal history and minimum sample must be set at P1, no assumed 21 valid dates.

constraints_checked.constraint: No broad US benchmark and less than illustrated 60-session history
constraints_checked.plan_response: Residual/beta not run, no zero-beta or unnamed benchmark substitution; separately named raw-strength experiment needs separate explicit P1 formula and acceptance.
Evidence-backed exposure construction is upstream of factor computation; proxy vocabulary and keyword counts not approved stock mappings.
20261013 retrospective is explicit; historical PIT unverified when versions absent; forward observations start from actual availability.

constraints_checked.constraint: User requests reselect HK Connect, not maximize count
constraints_checked.plan_response: Full eligible covered universe, unknown isolated, no tuning to number selected; historical effectiveness separate from engineering candidate output.
No oversold changes, no new producer/account/composite score; staged exact write ownership and preservation of parallel releases.

phase_dependency_review.P0: Discovery receipt/sample checks precede P1; this review does not independently certify those data quantities.
phase_dependency_review.P1: Build/review exposure evidence and freeze data-supported factor and main outcome before implementing calculation. No need to invent all-universe mappings to pass a valid first industry sample.
phase_dependency_review.P2: Single complete industry end-to-end canary before expanding covered scope, with late arrivals/holiday/cutoff counterexamples.
phase_dependency_review.P3: Full-date candidate engineering and historical/forward evaluation may progress separately; insufficient history leaves efficacy unverified, not a false backtest PASS.
phase_dependency_review.P4: Formal engineering release depends on candidate acceptance, preserving visible unvalidated status where appropriate.
phase_dependency_review.P5: Natural availability/slot and forward observations are separate, manual replay cannot qualify.

P1_required_freezes_already_deferred_by_: Name the actual computable first factor; no residual until benchmark and window requirements are satisfied.
Freeze return basis/session, benchmark if applicable, estimator/intercept/window/min observations and exclusion of current session from estimated beta.
Freeze one primary HK outcome relative to actual US session and HK decision instant; distinguish opening gap from post-open profit.
Version industry/proxy assignment, overlap weights/dedup, missing policy, approved directed company relationships and known-at/effective timestamps.
Fix training/validation/sealed or prospective dates, finite variants, metric/min sample/acceptance threshold and overlapping-label boundary handling before evaluation.
Freeze candidate rank/threshold/tie behavior and full coverage counts; unknown is not zero, rank is not validated alpha.
Target 20261013 already observed retrospective run is not a fresh sealed efficacy sample.
